 December 17, 2025
 Events, Holiday As we prepare to bid farewell to 2025 and welcome in 2026, there are exciting events happening that cater to all ages. From family-friendly activities to lively street parties, here’s your guide to celebrating New Year’s Eve in style!Kids Confetti Drop presented by Beachball PropertiesDate & Time: December 31 | 10 AM - 2 PMLocation: Main Street + Palms PlazaCost: FREE admission + parking; some activities range from $5-10Kick off your New Year’s celebrations early with the annual Kids Confetti Drop! This event is perfect for families with young children who may not be able to stay up until midnight. Enjoy a fun-filled day featuring:Bouncy inflatablesFace paintingCamel ridesPhoto 360Balloon artist + much more!The highlight of the day will be the confetti drop at noon, where kids can experience the joy of ringing in the New Year with colorful confetti and festivities. DJ Matt will keep the energy high from 10 AM to 2 PM, ensuring a memorable day for everyone.Reelin’ in the New YearDate & Time: December 31 | 5 PM - MidnightLocation: Main Street + Marlin CircleCost: FREE admission + parking; some kids’ activities cost $5-10As the sun sets, join us for the Reelin’ in the New Year Street Party, a vibrant celebration sponsored by Pepsi and Miller Lite. This event promises an unforgettable night filled with:Live music from local bandsFamily-friendly activitiesAdult-centered funDJ + Bands5-6 pm: DJ Matt + Kids Activities6-9 pm: Alan Mabry Duo 9 pm – midnight: Park BandThe evening will culminate at midnight with a spectacular fireworks display powered by White Claw and the iconic marlin drop!All-Day CelebrationsIce Skating Rink10 am - Midnight, white tent in front entrance parking lotAdmission to the rink is $15 and $20 for the ice skating and Ferris wheel combo package (price includes skate rental).Shopping10 am - 9 pm, various retailers at The WharfRetail shops and restaurants will be operating under extended business hours allowing guests to enjoy all the property has to offer prior to the celebration.Marlin Drop + FireworksCount down to the New Year with the signature Marlin Drop followed by the finale fireworks display presented by White Claw.SPECTRAThe Laser Light Experience will bring a high-powered theatrical show along Main Street at midnight following the fireworks.Late Night PartyHead over to The Sandshaker and toast the new year with High Cotton live until 1 am. Or Pop, fizz, and ring in the new year at Gulf Babe’s NYE Bash!Tips for a Fantastic New Year's EveArrive Early: Both events are free, so plan to arrive early to secure parking and enjoy all the activities without feeling rushed.Dress Comfortably: Whether you’re bouncing on inflatables or dancing at a street party, wear comfortable shoes and clothing.Stay Hydrated and Snack Smart: With so much excitement, don’t forget to drink water and grab some snacks to keep your energy up throughout the day and night.Capture the Moments: Bring your camera or smartphone to capture all the fun memories with family and friends.This New Year’s Eve, make it a celebration for everyone! With events like the Kids Confetti Drop and Reelin’ in the New Year, there’s something for every member of your family. So gather your loved ones, enjoy the festivities, and let’s welcome 2026 together! Light up your feed
